lines: ≪First, allow me introduce myself. I am called Arsal, and I am one who travels across dimensions.≫
≪The correct pronunciation is a bit more complicated, but I simplified it so that lower lifeforms like yourselves are able understand it.≫
...Yeah, let's just kill him, right little brother?
H-Hold on, nee-chan! Um, Arsal? What do you mean by... travelling across dimensions?
≪It means that we can travel freely and comfortably between dimensions, utilizing the pinnacle of technology, which we produced.≫
Traveling between dimensions... I've heard about that. If I remember correctly, a UFS scholar published a theory about a multi-dimensional universe... And this would mean that he was correct.
≪You didn't even know that? Very well then, I will explain it easily so that even lower lifeforms like yourselves can understand.≫
≪A dimension, or a "world" as you call it, is like a drop of water floating in a five-dimensional universe.≫
≪And we are moving through this five-dimensional universe, moving between drops of water, between "worlds."≫
So that means you came from another drop of water?
≪Our dimension is undergoing critically dangerous environmental change.≫
≪Therefore we are searching for a dimension suitable for a highly intelligent species like us.≫
≪And are currently doing surveys in several dimensions, while also exterminating the local pests.≫
And that's how you ended up in this dimension...
That must mean that Rinko-senpai and I had ended up in this dimension because we somehow got caught up in this octopus's dimensional travel.
You make it all sound so nice, but the point is that you are an interdimensional invader. Right, I'm going to cut you down.
≪Wait! Wait! It is true that the majority of us think that we should simply exterminate all lower lifeforms.≫
≪But I don't agree! I'm an environmental conservationist!≫
≪I am campaigning for the conservation of the natural environment of the dimension we migrate to. Of course, only up to the point where it doesn't interfere with our move.≫
≪I promise we are going to set up a nature reserve for you, somewhere at the edge of this world!≫
≪I'm sure even pests like you have something worth living for. We should not belittle you just because you are inferior to us!≫
I would have liked to kill him just as much. But if we killed him, we might not be able to get back to our original world.
There is one thing I would like to ask. When you travel between dimensions, is there a chance that other people get dragged with you?
≪Of course there is! Each jump between dimensions puts a lot of stress on the surrounding space.≫
≪You might bring lower lifeforms from a totally different dimension with you, and sometimes those species even start a war with the indigenous species!≫
≪But that is a small price to pay to ensure the future of our highly advanced species! Ahaha!≫
Rinko-senpai was already silently exuding a threatening aura.
R-Rinko nee-chan, please wait! So that we can return!
At least we now knew why we had arrived at this strange Gosha Academy.
(Now all we have to do is to somehow get back to our original world, but... hm?)
There was a sound as if something was cutting through the air.
It was Shikanosuke who had come falling from the sky. And behind himー
Monsters I had never seen before fell from the sky and chased after Shikanosuke, shouting in a language I had never heard before.
I don't really know what's going on, but... Uehara! I'm on my way!!!
